corkInitial: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: reusable web background texture for a quiet Japanese cork pinboard portal. Generate one square approximately 1024x1024 image of fine-grain natural cork, photographed perfectly perpendicular from directly above, filling the entire frame edge to edge. Small irregular cork chips and tiny fissures, a mix of pale honey, warm beige, subdued tan and sparse darker flecks. Natural organic clustered granules, no orderly dots or grid. Flat uniform diffuse illumination and constant average color across the entire frame, no shadows or directional shading, no vignette, no bright center or dark corners. Texture should work as a seamless repeat in both directions; left/right and top/bottom edges should match in grain density and color. At display scale 512px square most chips should be about 2-6 pixels wide, with no dominant large recognizable repeating features. Real tactile cork, understated low-to-medium contrast for readable dark headings placed over it. No board frame, paper, pins, tape, objects, writing, logos, watermark, scratches or stains. No transparent background.
